from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, os, statistics, subprocess, time

repo = Path.cwd()
task = repo / '.local/tool-tasks/hittable-default-callback-roi-20261009'
host = repo / '.local/tool-tasks/native-sort-storage-20261008/harness/OfflineSearchHarness.dll'
control = repo / '.local/tool-tasks/nonempty-pile-callback-contract-20261009/build-final/CombatSolver.dll'
candidate = task / 'build-candidate/CombatSolver.dll'
requests = Path('/home/ltlly/Code/nmslmod/CombatSolver-perf-20261001/.local/veryhigh-dop16/frozen-corpus/requests')
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(control) == 'e1117ccb7f5c5339e9abcc2e7ac29393ea07ff1bd2df88759140f2681467ea98'
assert sha(host) == '65d7d5c136bf9ca527be565a9cc7288430f8398994056c1ac72f31dca097c2e4'
quality_keys = ['score','projectedBattleHpLost','potionCount','onlyDeathRoutes','finalHp',
                'finalEnemyHp','combatEndedTurn','searchedTurns','shufflesCrossed','unavoidableHpLost','potionUses']
work_keys = ['totalExpanded','totalTransitions','totalChoiceBranches','maxParallelConcurrency']
env = os.environ.copy()
removed = [k for k in env if k.startswith(('COMPlus_', 'DOTNET_Jit', 'DOTNET_Perf', 'DOTNET_EnableDiagnostics'))]
for k in removed: env.pop(k)
runs = []
for root in ['holdout-04-necrobinder','dev-08-regent-boss']:
    reference = None
    for label in ['A1','C1','C2','A2']:
        out = task / 'screen' / root / label
        out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        dll = control if label.startswith('A') else candidate
        cmd = ['dotnet', str(host), '--request', str(requests/(root+'.json')),
               '--label','hitting-default-'+root+'-'+label,'--out',str(out),
               '--profile','VeryHigh','--dop','16','--budget-ms','60000',
               '--search-mode','Evaluate','--nodes','25000','--beam','135',
               '--card-branches','72','--pile-branches','42','--hand-branches','54',
               '--enable-no-gc-region','--no-gc-region-budget-gigabytes','16']
        env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(dll)
        meta = {'command':cmd,'environmentOverrides':{'OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL':str(dll)},
                'removedDiagnosticEnvironmentKeys':removed,'requestSha256':sha(requests/(root+'.json')),
                'hostSha256':sha(host),'dllSha256':sha(dll),'outerTimeoutSeconds':120,
                'noProfilerOrCorrectnessInstrumentation':True}
        (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2))
        start=time.monotonic()
        with (out/'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
            p=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=120)
        result=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text())
        harness=json.loads((out/'harness-result.json').read_text())
        metrics=result['solverMetrics']
        current={'root':root,'label':label,'exitCode':p.returncode,'processWallSeconds':time.monotonic()-start,
                 'status':result['status'],'timeBoundaryObserved':result['timeBoundaryObserved'],
                 'wallSeconds':result['wallSeconds'],'peakProcessWorkingSetBytes':result['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'],
                 'quality':{k:metrics[k] for k in quality_keys},'qualityScope':'eleven Evaluate fields; no complete Coordinator acceptance',
                 'work':{k:metrics[k] for k in work_keys},'evidence':str(out)}
        if reference is None: reference=(result,harness,current)
        rr,rh,rc=reference
        current.update(qualityEqual=current['quality']==rc['quality'],workEqual=current['work']==rc['work'],
                       rootEqual=result['rootContinuationStamp']==rr['rootContinuationStamp'],
                       liveEqual=harness['search']['rootLiveStamp']==rh['search']['rootLiveStamp'],
                       budgetEqual=result['budget']==rr['budget'],policyEqual=harness['searchPolicy']==rh['searchPolicy'])
        runs.append(current)
        (task/'screen-runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
        print(json.dumps(current,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
        assert p.returncode==0 and current['status']=='Passed'
groups=[]
for root in ['holdout-04-necrobinder','dev-08-regent-boss']:
    rows=[r for r in runs if r['root']==root]
    a=[r for r in rows if r['label'].startswith('A')]; c=[r for r in rows if r['label'].startswith('C')]
    groups.append({'root':root,'baselineSeconds':[r['wallSeconds'] for r in a],'candidateSeconds':[r['wallSeconds'] for r in c],
                   'medianSpeedup':statistics.median(r['wallSeconds'] for r in a)/statistics.median(r['wallSeconds'] for r in c),
                   'maximumCandidateRssOverMinimumControl':max(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in c)/min(r['peakProcessWorkingSetBytes'] for r in a),
                   'guardsPass':all(all(r[k] for k in ['qualityEqual','workEqual','rootEqual','liveEqual','budgetEqual','policyEqual']) and not r['timeBoundaryObserved'] for r in rows)})
(task/'screen-groups.json').write_text(json.dumps(groups,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(groups,indent=2),flush=True)
